text: The clinic is excellent
The doctor was kind and gave good advice. The clinic was clean and the staff were lovely.
Everything went great

Customer service is important .The dentist will do the work I ask for ,or I will go somewhere else where they will .Simple as that .lm not ever going to set foot in this establishment again or pay them any money .Because they don't want to listen to me and do what I want done

i went there as my veneer they implanted once again broke. it’s thursday, the dentist isn’t here for 2 days and i’m in pain and have no tooth.. they can’t provide a service for 2 days. this is in  my opinion terrible service for emergency or follow up care and i suggest people consider this before using there services.
We were there remotely, quickly and painlessly. Excellent staff.

If your insurance company offers you this clinic, refuse!!!!! The prices are outrageous, they're a bunch of quacks! I asked to have a filling replaced, they drilled out the entire tooth, opened the canals, and then paid cash for everything. In the end, they quoted me 15,000 baht! The temporary filling fell out the next day.
Very nice ladies. I think they thought I had a low threshold for pain. Because this session was the most painless I ever had. Fixed three teeth:)

I had my wisdom tooth removed. Everything went perfectly, no pain. They gave me anesthesia. The doctor also took X-rays and explained everything in detail, as well as for my other teeth. Basically, I had a full consultation and the extraction, and they gave me some pills for the trip. They sent me a WhatsApp message and had another consultation the next day. I highly recommend it. The doctor was a man, but I don't remember his name.
The best clinic! Accepted quickly and high-quality work! Thank you
Not open at 9:00 a.m. despite signage on their door and info on their appointment card.  I wanted to give them notice to cancel tomorrow's appointment.  Not a very good impression.

On January 21, 2025, I visited this clinic under my insurance policy. I must say right away that my visit was pleasant and the service was professional! First, they took a full jaw x-ray. On a large screen, they showed not only the source of the pain but also potential future problems elsewhere.
They offered me two options: I chose tooth extraction, removal of the pus, and wound healing, with a subsequent decision on implantation. The second option was root canal treatment with a success rate of up to 60%, but that wasn't my option.

The entire procedure was conducted with the help of a translator, with the doctor, a relatively young specialist, displaying information on a large screen and on the screen in front of me.
The doctor answered many of my questions, prescribed treatment after the extraction, and provided me with all the necessary medications. They also sent me a link on WhatsApp with instructions on measures to take after the tooth extraction.

From there, it's up to me to strictly take the prescribed medications.

Thank you very much to the staff at Your Dentist Pattaya Dental Clinic for your timely and high-quality assistance!
Excellent doctor, works with insurance companies, removed a nerve, and saw me the same day. I paid for the crown myself, the price is the same as in Russia. I highly recommend it.

As someone who's afraid of dentists even in my own country, I'll write this. The place is excellent! The staff is young but professional, and even under stress, they'll wait until you're ready to work. If you don't speak the language, as mentioned earlier, they have a translator available so you can communicate with them. They do their work very carefully and meticulously. They offer several treatment options. Some people say they had something done to them and then it fell off because they didn't follow the recommendations for further treatment. Or they simply refused the specific treatment they were given. Treatment options include those covered by insurance (with further recommendations) and those covered by insurance. The prices are much better compared to Russia.
In the end, they even prescribed pills (painkillers and antibiotics) that they didn't have to buy; they were simply given to them after the treatment!
Thank you!

Bomb, don't listen to the weaklings who are unhappy with something, everything is great there, you are told by a normal, adequate person whose opinion is adequate and worth a hundred opinions of different inadequate people 🙂👌👍Everything is great there. Inexpensive, fast, high-quality, the best place in Pattaya, the main thing is that there is a translator there and you understand what they are saying.

I went in with a wisdom tooth ache. I was referred through T Bank insurance. They removed the tooth and took an x-ray beforehand. They gave me some pills and instructions. Everything went great. The only downside was that I had to wait about 40 minutes after my appointment.

My insurance company referred me to them for severe pain. They charged 1,100 baht for an x-ray and consultation. They gave me pills that I was already taking and they stopped helping. I left in pain and didn't understand why they took the x-ray if they weren't going to help.

Communicating with the doctor via on-screen translator is very convenient. A very pleasant and kind doctor offered several options. The surgery was extremely comfortable. I was very pleased with everything. I highly recommend it. 👍 …

A week ago, I had a 7-year-old child's tooth extracted. They're one of the few places that has a pediatric dentist, and they scheduled an appointment for the next working day, even though they were fully booked! Everything went great, and the staff is very accommodating of the language barrier. If you don't understand something in English, they'll translate it into your native language right there on the computer screen. We also took 3D X-rays of all my teeth, and we've scheduled a follow-up appointment to have my other teeth treated. Thank you for your help 🙏🏻
Good clinic, low prices. They have a pediatrician.

Excellent clinic!
The doctor showed and explained everything without rushing, explaining what, why, and how to do it.
I liked it.
Went today for a denture repair cost 2000 Bht lasted 4 hours then broke waste of my money and time.
This wasn't our first time, everything was fine.
The internal retainer on one tooth came off. Came to this clinic, the doctor glued it back. They took 1 thousand baht for the work. But after 5 months, the retainer peeled off again. Badly.
The cost of dental treatment (cleaning the root canal) is 26,000 Baht.

Good afternoon! We were at the dentist. The clients were mostly children. We took an x-ray and had a bad tooth extracted. The consultation alone costs 100 baht. They showed the cartoon "Masha and the Bear." They were very polite and kind with the child. After the visit, they gave the child a choice of a gift: a balloon or stickers.

Lovely and professional clinic. I am visiting and had a tooth/gum infection, they booked me in within a couple days, when I saw them it was apparent my wisdom teeth needed pulling out which they kindly let me think about and then I said ok and they did it then and there. Really attentive as I was in quite a bit of pain so they put more painkiller in. Probably the best clinic I’ve ever been to. Price is reasonable and definitely worth it too

I would recommend this Dental surgery . The doctor he is first class . We agreed on a plan that he recommended.  I felt no pain with any of the work he carried out. I will go back in a few months for a check up,  and to get more work done. The doctor and all the staff are very helpful
Best dentist in pattaya, complete diagnosis and give your alternative suggestions

I went in for 1 broken tooth. The lady dentist CONvinced me she had to remove TWO teeth and I had several fillings needing doing.
I thought she knew what she was doing and agreed.
She had a temporary denture made which after 1 month of pain for me, she refunded the 1600 baht and took denture back.
After coming back to NZ over the next 6 months ALL of the fillings fell out one by one.
A very BAD dentist.
Great Dentist. All the ladies were very nice and did a great job!!!!!!!!
There's a language translator and good equipment. Attentive service. We're from Russia. It's easy to communicate with the doctor.
The children's dentist is excellent!!!!!
Unfriendly staff. I'm stopping using their service. The staff were rude.

good and carefully dentist. speaks english well and value for money. if u need to check up ur tooth and clean from plaque, i can recommend it. for more treatments u maybe should talk early enough to him to get an appointment in the time you stay in Pattaya
